Identify Labels that Refer to Totals

age_is_total.Rd

Return a logical vector the same length as x with TRUE for labels that agetime interprets as totals, and FALSE otherwise.

Usage

age_is_total(x, unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent"))

Arguments

x

Vector of age group labels.

unknown_label

Action if meaning of label unclear. Choices are "error" (the default), "warn", and "silent".

Value

A logical vector

Examples

x <- c("20-24", "Total", "100+", "ALL")
age_is_total(x)
#> [1] FALSE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE
